name: Membrane CO2 removal for high-CO2 gas
applications: bulk CO2 removal ahead of amines
principle: Gas flows past a polymer membrane. CO2, H2S and water dissolve into and diffuse through the polymer faster than methane, so they collect on the low-pressure permeate side while methane stays at pressure in the residue. Pretreatment protects the membrane from liquids and heavy hydrocarbons, and two stages or a permeate compressor can be used to reduce methane losses.
